title: UTokyo Amgen Scholars Program

compensation.value: Airfare, accommodation and living allowances covered by the program
compensation.evidence_quote: Expenses such as airfare, accommodation, and living allowances are covered by the program.

about: The UTokyo Amgen Scholars Program is a summer research internship in bioscience and biotechnology, 3 June to 5 August 2027, for undergraduates at Asian universities. Online applications run 1 November 2026 to 1 February 2027, 3 p.m. JST. Airfare, accommodation and living allowances are covered.
requirements: Undergraduates at colleges or universities across the Asia region that award a bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
At least first year completed; must return to undergraduate study for at least one term afterwards
Not open to students who have previously earned a bachelor's degree
Two recommenders, one a faculty member at the current institution
English test scores if English is not the language of instruction (e.g. TOEFL iBT 72 or IELTS 5.5)
